crossRefs.note: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

translations.web: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
translations.bsb: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
translations.kjv: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
translations.asv: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power. Psalm 22 For the Chief Musician; set to Aijaleth hash-Shahar. A Psalm of David.
